attack_techniques: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify System Firewall (T1562.004)
attackers_goals: Firewall rules determine what traffic your firewall will block or allow. A malicious insider might want to change these rules in an attempt to bypass network limitations or disrupt network communication.
description: A user added a new Windows Firewall rule. Adding a firewall rule may indicate an attempt to bypass controls limiting network usage or to disrupt network communications.
investigative_actions: Check for any other suspicious activity related to the host and the user involved in the alert. Check Windows Defender Firewall with Advanced Security for a new rule that was added. Check if the new rule was added to different machines as well.
name: A user added a Windows firewall rule
required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
